interpretations: For each media type name, calculate total known bytes divided by the total milliseconds of tracks with known bytes. Select names whose rates exceed the simple average of those rates, then report the selected names’ mean rate, mean eligible track count, and mean absolute rate difference from that benchmark.

For each media type name, calculate total known bytes divided by the total milliseconds of all its tracks, including tracks with unknown bytes in the duration. Select names above the simple average of those rates, then report their mean rate, mean total track count, and mean absolute rate difference.

For each media type name, treat unknown byte counts as zero and calculate total bytes divided by total milliseconds. Select names above the simple average of those rates, then report their mean rate, mean track count, and mean absolute rate difference.

For each media type name, average the individual bytes-per-millisecond rates of tracks with known bytes. Select names above the simple average of the media-type rates, then report their mean rate, mean eligible track count, and mean absolute rate difference.

For each media type name, average the individual bytes-per-millisecond rates of tracks with known bytes. Select names above the simple average of the media-type rates, then report their mean rate, mean count of all tracks assigned that name, and mean absolute rate difference.

Calculate a rate separately for each media type ID, use the simple average of those ID-level rates as the benchmark, and average the results for qualifying IDs while displaying or identifying them by name.
Combine media type IDs that share a name before calculating their rates and track counts; treat each distinct name as one media type in both the benchmark and the final averages.
Include media types with no tracks in the benchmark as having a zero rate and zero tracks, then average the rates, counts, and absolute differences for the media types above that benchmark.
For qualifying media types, report the mean percentage by which their rates exceed the overall average as the “average margin,” alongside their mean rate and mean track count.
Treat tracks with unknown bytes as having a zero individual rate, then average individual rates within each media type name.
For each media type name, divide the average known byte count by the average duration of all its tracks, allowing the two averages to use different track sets.
For qualifying media type names, report their combined bytes divided by their combined milliseconds as the “average rate,” alongside the mean track count and mean margin.
queries:
WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS eligible_track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.Name
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
    FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(r.rate) AS mean_rate,
    AVG(r.eligible_track_count) AS mean_eligible_track_count,
    AVG(ABS(r.rate - b.average_rate)) AS mean_absolute_rate_difference
FROM media_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE r.rate > b.average_rate

WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count,
        1.0 * COALESCE(SUM(t.Bytes), 0) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
selected AS (
    SELECT rate, track_count
    FROM media_rates
    WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_rates)
),
selected_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate
    FROM selected
)
SELECT
    selected_mean.mean_rate,
    AVG(selected.track_count) AS mean_total_track_count,
    AVG(ABS(selected.rate - selected_mean.mean_rate)) AS mean_absolute_rate_difference
FROM selected
CROSS JOIN selected_mean

WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count,
    1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(t.Bytes, 0)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.rate) AS mean_rate,
  AVG(m.track_count) AS mean_track_count,
  AVG(ABS(m.rate - a.rate)) AS mean_absolute_rate_difference
FROM media_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE m.rate > a.rate

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS eligible_track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
      AND t.Milliseconds > 0
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
    GROUP_CONCAT(m.Name, ', ') AS names,
    AVG(m.rate) AS mean_rate,
    AVG(m.eligible_track_count) AS mean_eligible_track_count,
    AVG(ABS(m.rate - o.rate)) AS mean_absolute_rate_difference
FROM media_type_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE m.rate > o.rate

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS mean_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.Name
),
known_rate_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS mean_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.Name
    HAVING COUNT(t.Bytes) > 0
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(mean_rate) AS mean_rate
    FROM known_rate_counts
)
SELECT
    AVG(k.mean_rate) AS mean_rate,
    AVG(k.track_count) AS mean_track_count,
    AVG(ABS(k.mean_rate - o.mean_rate)) AS mean_absolute_rate_difference
FROM known_rate_counts AS k
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE k.mean_rate > o.mean_rate;
